name: enrich_candidate
description: LLM-powered re-analysis of one candidate. The deterministic intake parser produces a baseline dossier + score; this workflow layers real understanding on top: rewrites the dossier prose, refines the score against the role rubric, and sharpens the next-action. Manual trigger from the candidate detail page ('Analyze with AI'). Requires the pod's runtime profile to have an LLM model configured — on cloud this is automatic (system:lemma), on local it requires the operator to wire one. If no model is available the agent node fails and the deterministic dossier stays untouched.

candidate_id.description: UUID of the candidate row to re-analyze.

nodes.label: Read dossier + role context, produce richer rewrite
